# Pull Request

## 1. Description
A clear and concise summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## 2. Research & Architectural Alignment
- [ ] Conforms to principles in `research/00-project-charter/foundational-principles.md`
- [ ] Related to Issue / RFC / ADR: #
- [ ] Benchmarks or empirical data included (if claiming performance improvements)

## 3. Type of Change
- [ ] Research Document / Paper
- [ ] Architectural Specification / RFC / ADR
- [ ] Core Runtime Code
- [ ] SDK / Developer Tooling
- [ ] Documentation / Community Governance

## 4. DCO Sign-off
- [ ] All commits include `Signed-off-by: Author <email>` in accordance with `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
